parsed.explanation: No criminalisation of gender identity or consensual sex, sodomy struck down, and a 2024 hate-crime statute covering gender identity with an Equality Court that in Nov 2025 ordered prescribed gender-affirming care and gender-expressing clothing in detention - functioning recourse. A Dec 2024 severe tavern assault led to arrest. Against this: documented disproportionate violence against trans people in townships, a 2024 police mockery/denial of help after ID shown, and facility access legally contested with no court ruling in record - an open question, not a documented universal ban. Border screening and trans-specific rates are undocumented, public opinion is dated 2017, and detention SOP implementation is questioned. Strong protections with uneven street-level enforcement place this in reduced-risk, below consistently documented acceptance.
